pilot.probe: The first probe was planned with the earrings as a third step. Earrings VTO refused the chest-up photo: "[PHOTO_CHECK_INVALID] Ear size should fit in range and position should be in the center." YouCam refunded that charge, and look 1 is that probe's first two steps. The necklace was added to each look afterwards, on its lipstick result, with look 2's crew neck as the probe; the top and lipstick were not made again.

gate: Show recorded looks only if each result keeps the top's design, puts the lipstick on the lips alone, hangs the necklace at the neck at a believable length, keeps the person recognisably the same from step to step, and delay and cost fit the owner-approved budget.
owner_decision: On 28 October 2026 the owner made looks the top and lipstick, after Earrings VTO refused the probe's photo, and chose to publish the three looks as recorded results. Later that day the owner approved adding the necklace from the order to each look, 1 unit each, and publishing them. Per-look ratings are not yet recorded.

reading.by: Claude (AI assistant), 28 October 2026, before the owner's ratings
